subject: cn-info
title: CN.INFO.------AF.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 492 (MP(II)-10). CN-INFO (controlled information) is the subject; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", RIT-DY (ritual dynamics) and AF-COMP (affinity compression). From POST: ATT (attitude). From RIT-DY: INFO-DE (information degrees). From AF-COMP: DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center). From ATT: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree). From INFO-DE: TR (transformation). From DIS-C-CT: POL-P (political policies). From AFI-2: SOC-RT (social reality). From TR: AFI (affinity insight).
